🇹🇼 Super Typhoon Ragasa Triggers Lake Breach and Flooding in Eastern Taiwan

🌊 On Tuesday, September 23, 2025, eastern Taiwan experienced a devastating flood: the breach of a long-standing barrier lake, formed by a landslide, washed away a bridge and inundated the nearby town. More than 260 people were trapped.

🌧 The lake formed due to torrential rains brought by Super Typhoon Ragasa. Heavy rains and strong winds, which hit the northern Philippines and Taiwan on Monday, had already forced thousands of people to evacuate.

⏱️ In Hualien County, the breach occurred around 15:00 local time (07:00 GMT) in the upper reaches of the Mataiyan Stream. The situation remains critical, with emergency services on site assisting the affected population.

⚠️ These events highlight the destructive power of typhoons and the urgent need for preparedness for extreme weather events in the region.

⏰ Since the end of 2024 our planet has entered  the 12,000-year cycle. We as humanity are not ready for this, neither scientifically, nor technically or in terms of morality and humaneness. But we still have a little bit of time left to curb the climatic Cerberus....  🌀

👀 To learn more about the reasons of the increasing natural disasters and the way out of it, read the report ON THE PROGRESSION OF CLIMATIC DISASTERS ON EARTH AND THEIR CATASTROPHIC CONSEQUENCES

🚨 Traffic Advisory – RJNR Traffic - Kishan Bagh 🚨

On the occasion of Shaheedi Divas Yatra of the Sikh community, around 5000 participants are proceeding towards Gurudwara from Kishan Bagh X Road (Hyd City limits) and are now passing Pakeeza Hotel (Cyb).

➡️ Vehicular traffic is not being allowed on the opposite side of the procession.

➡️ Traffic is diverted at 9 Number towards NM Guda & Attapur.

 The situation is peaceful and under control. Commuters passing by are requested to make note and plan the travel accordingly and expect traffic congestion in the route.

#TrafficUpdate #CyberabadTrafficPolice #TrafficDiversion
